title: Public transport tickets
question: What happens if I travel on public transport without a ticket in Poland?
short_answer: You will receive a fine. Always validate your ticket immediately after boarding.
conditions: Tickets must be validated (stempel) at the beginning of each journey
Single-use tickets must be validated within the vehicle
Monthly/period passes must be registered to your name
Show your ticket when asked by an inspector
exceptions: Children under 4 travel free on most city networks
Disabled persons with valid ID may travel free in many cities
Senior citizens (60+/65+) often have free or reduced travel
penalties: Fine: 150–600 PLN depending on the city for travelling without a valid ticket
Reduced fine if paid on the spot (within the vehicle)
Higher fine if paid later (within 7 days)
